svg.title: Pet Care Tracker screen flow map, elaborated
svg.desc: Pet list is the home base screen. It leads forward to Add/Edit Pet and to Pet Profile. Pet Profile leads forward to Feeding Schedule, Vaccination Log, and Health Records Log. Dashed arrows show how Add/Edit Pet returns to either Pet List or Pet Profile depending on entry point, and how the detail screens return to Pet Profile via the back button.
svg.text: Thicker border on Pet list marks it as the home base screen.
